def _preprocess_options(run: Run, args: Sequence[str]) -> list[str]:

**Root cause:** The `-v` short flag was never registered. - `pylint/config/argument.py` — `_CallableArgument` now accepts/stores a `metavar`
- `pylint/config/arguments_manager.py` — passes `metavar` through when building the argparse action
- `pylint/lint/base_options.py` — `--verbose` and `--enable-all-extensions` get `metavar: ""` so argparse treats them as valueless flags (also fixes the `--verbose , -v` help rendering)
